title: Choose the one-screen landing · blueprint throughout
question: Re-rolled with your steer: the blueprint ground everywhere, little text, one dramatic moment.

options.label: The building elevation
options.thesis: Tower B drawn as a white-line elevation on the blueprint, six floors tall. One floor, Flat 302, glows: its twelve windows lit, nine green, two rust, one dashed, stamped 9 of 12. Headline, one sentence and the button on the left; one thin line for how it works and who it's for.
options.viewport: Left: 'Proof of progress, flat by flat.' at 96px, one sentence, the demo button. Right, full height: the tower elevation; Flat 302's floor outlined in orange with its twelve windows lit; a 9 of 12 stamp beside it. Foot: READ → PLACE → COUNT → JUDGE · for builders, buyers and banks. Signature: on load the windows of Flat 302 light one by one, then the stamp presses. Phone: headline, button, tower below.
options.risk: The tower is illustrative: Flat 302's real windows are across five rooms, not one facade.

raised.raise: One signal on a quiet field: only Flat 302 lights; every other line stays a drawing.
A marked place: the orange leader and label put a finger on the one flat that matters.

options.label: The builder's phone
options.lineage: before and after, on the phone
options.thesis: Two phones drawn in white line on the blueprint: the WhatsApp-style clips a builder already sends, an orange arrow, and the report a buyer pays against: the claim, 9 of 12, the tally, the stamps.
options.viewport: Left: 'Forward the clip. Get paid on proof.' and the button. Right: phone one with two clips and a 'Stage 6 done' message; dashed orange arrow; phone two with the claim, 9 of 12, tally, stamps and a frame. Captions under each. Foot line. Signature: the arrow draws and the report fills in. Phone: the two phones stack.
options.risk: The left phone looks like WhatsApp; it must stay a generic drawing, not an imitation of the app.

options.label: The stamped ledger
options.thesis: The demand letter's three lines as three giant ledger rows across the full width, each with a big stamp pressed at its end: 9 of 12, 4 of 5, Not checked. Headline above, button top right.
options.viewport: Top: 'Every claim, stamped with proof.' at 96px, the button to the right. Middle: three 140px rows, each quote in highlighter at 40px, each stamp at 56px. Foot line. Signature: the stamps press down one after another. Phone: rows stack quote over stamp.
options.risk: Typographic only; no picture of the evidence itself.

options.label: Oscilloscope bench
options.kept: One signal on a quiet field.

options.label: Acetate tab board
options.case: Declined: acetate and shadows fight flat blueprint.

options.label: Treasure map
options.case: Declined: adventure tone, not payment support.
